comment: Read from the maker's source at commit 6651d58, the only commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.2.0, and that file is byte-identical to the installed one. Every control and jack has a widget, so all of them are covered. The manual disagrees with the code in two places. It says polyphonic cables can carry mults to LEFT and RIGHT: both outputs are written with a plain setVoltage and no setChannels, so they are mono. And it gives the delay buffer as about 22.8 seconds at 48kHz, where the buffer is 2 to the 19th samples, which is 10.9 seconds at that rate; the knob's own 10ms to 2 second range is what a reader meets either way, so no buffer figure is quoted in the lines. The manual also describes the pitch jitter as about 0.08 semitones; the code adds it in volts, so the scale factor is 0.08 of an octave, though the jitter itself is smoothed so heavily that the audible wander is far smaller than either figure, and no number for it is quoted. FEEDBACK is the one delay knob with no CV jack. The MIDI menu items are Rack's own, named from the application's English translation file.
